title: LLM Applications
description: Prompts as versioned components with held-out evaluation.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can version a prompt in Git, define a metric before looking at a second prompt's score, and run it on a held-out list — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can show failures not only wins, keep a no-LLM baseline (keyword rule or smaller classifier), and record cost or latency as an order of magnitude.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently treat prompts as versioned components, evaluate on held-out cases written before tuning, and refuse a 'feels better' change that does not move the metric.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose an eval written after seeing outputs, or a prompt that wins on vibes and loses on the harness, and produce a failure set another engineer can rerun.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's prompt pack, name an eval written after tuning or a missing no-LLM baseline, and teach when to keep the keyword rule on an unfamiliar task.
